entries.zh: 誊抄、抄录（如书籍文字）；草拟
entries.en: to copy out (as one does books); to draft
entries.notes: 汉字「拟」与音写「chau pia n」不尽相应（chau 近「抄」），义依西语 trasladar（照书誊录）暂立；T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: to draw up a document or memorial
entries.notes: 汉字「平起表」与西语「照书誊录」对应不明，音写「lay」近「来(lâi)」而非「表(piáu)」，无从定夺；T99 污损触发降级

entries.zh: 抄白，照录信件原文；草拟白话
entries.en: to copy out a letter verbatim; plain transcript
entries.notes: 音写「chau pe」近「抄白」而非「拟白」，汉西对应以抄录信件解；T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: to copy out, transcribe; to draft in writing
entries.notes: 音写「chau sia」近「抄写」，「拟/抄」形近难辨，依西语 trasladar 定为誊抄义；T99 污损触发降级

entries.zh: 法帖，供临摹习字之范帖；照帖摹写
entries.en: a copybook, model calligraphy for copying in writing
entries.notes: 汉「法帖」与音写「huar tiap」密合，义为习字范帖；「p」缩写展开依赖推断且 T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: to stay up all night; to spend the night
entries.notes: 汉「坐眠」为罕见组合，依西语 trasnochar（熬夜、过夜）立义；T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: to lose sleep, be sleepless
entries.notes: 单字「失」为「失眠」之省，取同页「失精神／无眠」平行语境推断

entries.zh: 失神、精神萎靡（熬夜耗神）
entries.en: to lose one's spirit, be listless
entries.notes: 汉「失精神」与音写「fit cheng sin」密合，释义无碍，唯 T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: sleepless, without sleep
〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字、音写、官话三栏俱空，仅存西语词头（透明而发光），无从立义

entries.en: to pass through, penetrate
to pass through, go through
entries.notes: 汉「通」与音写「tong」密合，释义无碍，唯 T99 污损触发降级

entries.zh: 传递（亚当传下之原罪）；连累、累及
entries.en: to pass on the sin inherited from Adam; to implicate, involve others in guilt
entries.notes: 西语为「亚当原罪遗传」神学义；音写并列「sou lui／ion lui／lui quip」诸变体，「ion」一形未能定字，且 T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: to transfer a debt, assign payment
to take over, transfer (a debt)
entries.notes: 汉「撿」（音近 kím）与音写「quiau」不相应，或为「缴」之误辨，义依西语「转让债务」暂立

entries.en: to offer up, tender (in payment of a debt)
entries.notes: 汉「献」与音写「hien」密合，唯与西语「转让债务」之义相承稍疏，取呈交偿付之义略存推断

entries.en: to transgress the law and break it
entries.notes: 汉「越」与西语「违法背约」义密合，释义无碍，唯音写栏[残]触发降级

entries.en: to involve another in one's guilt, be a burden of blame
entries.notes: 首字「所」与音写「hou」不甚相应（或为「负累」），依西语「罪责转加」及同组「连累／累及」立义；T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: to implicate, involve (someone in guilt)
entries.notes: 汉「连累」与音写「lien lui」密合，释义无碍，唯 T99 污损触发降级

entries.en: to drag in, implicate (others in guilt)
entries.notes: 汉「累及」与音写「lui quip」密合，释义无碍，唯 T99 污损触发降级
